aiGuidance.summary: The SemanticOps programme: a shared database of the roadmap (objectives, periods, epics), the method records (problems, remedies, personas) and standing research, written by the owner and by agents. Read the purpose record first; the settings record cfb14770 holds the programme settings.
aiGuidance.navigationHints: Areas: roadmap (objectives, periods, epics; priority is derived from period objective_rank, so change the rank, never a priority), method (com.semanticops.method/problem, problem_id SP-nn, plus remedies, clusters, personas), Research (container 2f14de07), Narrative explorations (80b283ef: owner vignettes, Tier-0 notes tagged vignette, one conversation container each). Method records live in two containers: Suggestions (agents write; each with its own session actor) and Affirmed (human layer; only the owner adopts a suggestion, by fork with derived-from). The same problem can therefore appear twice: the Affirmed copy is the one that counts; tell them apart by container (Suggestions or Affirmed) and by the Affirmed copy's derived-from link to its suggestion; createdBy does not distinguish them. Set aside is the owner's reversible decline. Programme waves 1-5 and v12 records are frozen history. Shared containers: members add or remove, never update the container. Here, never hand-edit records or the manifest, and open a PR with gate:auto-merge.
